# Inactive workflow references

These files preserve the former GitHub setup for reference only. GitHub does not discover workflows
here. Do not move them back or dispatch/re-enable GitHub Actions without an explicit user request.
Use `pnpm ci:local`; setup, gate mapping and limitations are in
[the CI guide](../../docs/process/ci-cd.md). Archived paths, actions and deployment placeholders are
historical and are not maintained as an executable pipeline.
